name: Retell AI
positioning: A pay-as-you-go voice agent platform with a visual flow builder and API, bundling voice infrastructure in the per-minute rate while LLM, voice and telephony are priced as selectable line items.

pricing.model: Pay as you go, no subscription: a voice infrastructure rate plus the chosen LLM, voice and telephony per minute, with optional add-ons; custom enterprise pricing.
pricing.headline: $0.07 to $0.31 per minute depending on the model and voice chosen; voice infrastructure is $0.055 per minute, and the vendor's example configuration totals $0.11 per minute.
planNotes: Pay-as-you-go includes full platform access and 20 concurrent calls free; additional concurrency is $8 per concurrent call per month.
Enterprise: custom pricing, custom MSA/DPA, SSO, role-based access control, no cap on concurrent calls.
Example from the page: Retell platform voice $0.015, LLM about $0.04 (varies by model), voice infrastructure $0.055 = $0.11 per minute.
Phone numbers: $2 per month for US and Canada numbers purchased from Retell; US toll-free $5 per month (docs).
Testing is billed at production rates (docs).
whatIsExtra: LLM: per-minute, depends on model (examples: GPT 4.1 mini $0.0128, GPT 5 $0.04, Claude Sonnet $0.064 to $0.08)
Text-to-speech: $0.015 per minute for Retell platform voices; ElevenLabs voices $0.04 to $0.10 per minute
Telephony: about $0.015 per minute on Retell Twilio/Telnyx numbers; no charge for custom telephony/SIP trunking
Optional add-ons: Knowledge Base +$0.005/min, Advanced Denoising +$0.005/min, Safety Guardrails +$0.005/min, PII Removal +$0.01/min, Batch Call +$0.005/dial, Branded Call +$0.10 per outbound call
Phone number $2/month, verified phone number $10/month, SMS $0.01 per message

strengths.claim: True pay-as-you-go with no contract and 20 concurrent calls included, so small teams can start without a sales call.
Wide choice of LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, custom LLM over WebSocket) and voice providers with transparent per-minute rates listed publicly.
Self-service BAA and DPA signing at no extra fee, with per-agent data retention and PII controls documented.
Broad telephony options: Retell-purchased numbers or custom telephony via elastic SIP trunking, with guides for Twilio, Telnyx, Vonage, Genesys, Five9 and Avaya.
Built-in tooling beyond calls: simulation testing, AI quality assurance, batch calling, call transfer, SMS and verified/branded caller ID.

limitations.claim: Retell-purchased phone numbers are limited to the US and Canada, and outbound calls from them are supported to 15 countries; other countries need custom telephony.
Per-minute cost varies widely ($0.07 to $0.31) with model and voice, and several features (knowledge base, denoising, guardrails, PII removal) are priced as per-minute add-ons.
The vendor states it does not currently operate services within the European Union.

integrations: Google Drive, OneDrive and Notion knowledge-base sync

compliance.note: Stated by vendor, self-attested: documentation says HIPAA compliant (BAA required), SOC 2 Type 1 and Type 2 certified, and GDPR compliant via AWS with a DPA. A Vanta trust center is referenced but was not opened.

telephony.providedNumbers: Retell sells US and Canada numbers ($2 per month; US toll-free $5 per month); custom telephony via SIP trunking or SIP URI is supported with no Retell charge for the trunk.

stepsToLeave: Retrieve agent settings with the List/Get Voice Agent API and the prompt/states with the Get Retell LLM or conversation flow endpoints.
List knowledge bases with the List Knowledge Bases API and keep your original source documents or URLs.
List phone numbers with the List Phone Numbers API; numbers imported through SIP trunking remain with your carrier and can be repointed.
Call and chat history can be exported to CSV from the dashboard.
Recreate the prompt, tools and knowledge base in the new platform and test before cutting over.

bestFor: Teams that want a self-serve, usage-priced voice agent platform with a visual builder and a wide choice of models and voices, from startups through regulated enterprises.

sources.title: Retell docs: Call and chat history

unknowns: Exact HIPAA/BAA availability by plan is shown in a comparison table whose cell values we could not read; the compliance documentation says BAA/DPA self-signing has no additional fee.
Whether Retell-provided numbers can be ported out was not found.
The Vanta trust center was not opened.
The pricing page lists future-dated model names; per-model rates should be re-checked on the live page before quoting a specific model price.
